long_biography.plain_text:
Kalelioğlu studied international business at the University of Innsbruck and completed an MBA in the United States before joining Arkas Holding. He entered the group in 2004, advanced to director and later vice president. In 2019 he became president for port and terminal services, building a career around Turkey's expanding container infrastructure.

Under his leadership, the group modernized container-handling capacity, expanded automotive-terminal facilities and developed rail links intended to connect Asian and European freight corridors. Railport paired Arkas's marine-terminal experience with duisport's inland-hub expertise, while Marport investments increased capacity to serve larger container ships. He has argued that Turkey's location can make its ports and rail hubs a bridge between Asian and European trade routes.
